title: Not worth the money
text: Not worth the money. I bought two different bathroom sets from separate makers. This set is cheaply made. The trash can broke within the first month. If you pick it up by the rim or sides it just breaks off. It should last longer than month before it starts breaking

product_metadata.title: sss Southwestern Beaded Navajo Bathroom Vanity Set
description: Colorful beads and a weathered wood texture are crafted from resin on the southwestern Navajo Bath Set. Included in the set are a rinse cup,toothbrush holder,soap dish, lotion pump,tissue box cover,and small wastebasket.

details.Included Components: Toothbrush Holder, Rinsing Mug, Soap Dish
